items.q: How long does it take to build a website?
items.a: Between 7 and 21 working days, depending on the complexity of the project.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: Prices start from £500 for a simple brochure site. Contact me for a free quote.

50% deposit before work begins, 50% upon delivery. Instalments available for larger projects.

items.q: Can I edit the website myself?
items.a: Yes! I build on CMS platforms like WordPress so you can easily update content without technical knowledge.

items.q: Will the site be SEO optimised?
items.a: Yes — every site includes on-page SEO basics: titles, meta descriptions, heading structure, and fast loading.

items.q: Will the site work on mobile?
items.a: Absolutely. All sites are built with Responsive Web Design for phones, tablets, and desktops.

items.q: What do I need to prepare before we start?
items.a: Ideally: a logo, page texts, photos, and examples of sites you like.

items.q: Do you offer support after launch?
items.a: Yes — revisions are free for 30 days. Paid maintenance packages are also available.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with the result?
items.a: We go through an approval stage before launch where you can request revisions. I work until you're satisfied.
